# Measured results

<!-- Generated by `node analyse.mjs`. Do not edit by hand: edit the script. -->

Numbers only, with no interpretation. What they mean is in
[CONCLUSION.md](CONCLUSION.md). Why the experiment is built this way is in
[METHODOLOGY.md](METHODOLOGY.md). How to reproduce it is in [README.md](README.md).

## Provenance

|                                   |                                                |
| --------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| Dates                             | 2026-08-23 to 2026-08-25                       |
| Models seen in payloads           | `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`, `claude-sonnet-5` |
| Agent                             | Claude Code CLI, `claude -p`                   |
| Payloads on disk                  | 395                                            |
| Excluded: network or server error | 0                                              |
| Excluded: change did not land     | 1                                              |
| Analysed                          | 394                                            |

Every run is checked twice before it counts: the app must still build, and a
task-specific assertion on the source must pass. Haiku appears in every payload because
the CLI uses it for internal work; it is about 1% of the spend.

Column meanings, once, for every table below:

| Column       | Meaning                                                                                             |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Runs         | Runs that landed the change, out of payloads present. `(unchecked)` means no log recorded a verdict |
| Cost         | Median `total_cost_usd`, then the min and max across runs                                           |
| Time         | Median wall clock in seconds, then min and max                                                      |
| Turns        | Median round trips to the model                                                                     |
| Read / Edit  | Distinct files opened and written, counted from the session transcript                              |
| Out          | Median output tokens                                                                                |
| In           | Median input tokens including cache creation and cache reads                                        |
| New / Replay | Median cache-creation and cache-read tokens. New tokens bill about 12x replayed ones                |

## Comparisons

All ratios are layered divided by flat. Above 1 means the layered app cost more.
`p` values below 0.05 are bold. `floor` marks a comparison whose sample is too small
to ever reach 0.05.

Three metrics are tested per task, on three comparisons. At that count a few results
below 0.05 are expected by chance, so a lone borderline p is weak on its own; a large
effect repeated across all three comparisons is not.
